name: COMP_048
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (62%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs Benign · Careful review
Benign (33%) stays in the 90% conformal set [F1], with tumor called at three simulated frozen-section margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 62%, Benign 33%, InSitu 5%, Normal 0% | Leans invasive; benign not excluded |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive (10% alpha; 90% dataset coverage) | Cannot separate invasive from benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 76th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical image; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match top call |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive (60%; 88%–90% similarity), 2/5 InSitu [F5] | Mixed invasive and in-situ neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 5, 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+1.13; 19/20 AI check) favors invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.11; +0.62 contribution), unreliable (0/20 check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 10) · context · Above-typical descriptive TILs (-0.59; 8/20 check) [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (-0.18; +0.51; 20/20 check) favors invasive · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · High (+0.41; 18/20 check) vs in-situ BACH_0063 · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region deletion beats random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, excludes 0); heatmap is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion overlaps random (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064, unverified); case uses unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20), `mitoses` (0/20), `necrosis` (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions represent in-situ carcinoma (like 89%-similar `BACH_0063`) or benign mimic (33% probability, inside conformal set).
- Simulated composite frozen-section artifacts distort margin calls where stains are blocked and calibration error spans 4%–22% (n=132).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 5, 8, 9**: Confirm stromal invasion and pleomorphism versus in-situ (`BACH_0063`) or benign mimics.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8**: Verify tumor at medial (323 µm), superior (215 µm), inferior (108 µm) margins.
3. **Regions 2, 7, 10, 11**: Check low-risk right half for validated tubules, weak TILs, and duct-confined cells.
